backend_endpoints: GET /api/auth/mfa/status - Returns MFA status for authenticated user
POST /api/auth/mfa/setup-totp - Generates TOTP secret + QR code
POST /api/auth/mfa/verify-setup - Verifies TOTP code to enable MFA
POST /api/auth/login - Returns mfa_required=true when MFA enabled
POST /api/auth/mfa/verify-totp - Exchanges mfa_token + TOTP for access_token
POST /api/auth/mfa/send-email-otp - Sends email OTP for login
POST /api/auth/mfa/verify-email-otp - Exchanges mfa_token + OTP for access_token
frontend_components: MFAChallenge.jsx - MFA challenge component for login with Authenticator/Email tabs
MFASettings.jsx - MFA setup/disable settings page with QR code display
LoginPage.js - Shows MFAChallenge when mfaChallenge state is set
AuthContext.js - Added mfaChallenge, mfaEnforced, completeMfaLogin, cancelMfa
Sidebar.jsx - Added 'Security (MFA)' nav item under ADMIN section
